module: Reffelt-Shadow block cipher layer (encrypt, decrypt, shadow walk)

extra.name: c
extra.label: the app's hand-tuned C kernel, built as the app builds it (gcc -O3)

extra.name: c_native
extra.label: the same C kernel built for this CPU (gcc -O3 -march=native)

extra.name: c_clang
extra.label: the same C kernel built for this CPU (clang -O3 -march=native)

extra.name: k_c
extra.label: cipher only, no text handling: the app's C kernel built as the app builds it (gcc -O3)

extra.name: k_c_native
extra.label: cipher only, no text handling: the same C kernel built for this CPU (gcc -O3 -march=native)

extra.name: k_c_clang
extra.label: cipher only, no text handling: the same C kernel built for this CPU (clang -O3 -march=native)

note: Amni-Crypt ships a hand-tuned C kernel (SIMD tables, 803 lines) for this layer; it is timed too, built three ways, on the whole job and on the cipher alone (KERNEL=1: cases decoded first, only encrypt, decrypt and shadow walk timed).
